notes.title: Rhodes Update, Out Now!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that our final update of early access, the Rhodes update, is now out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/237a4145546d2342e389b4b01793a2d0ad0d8cb7.png[/img]

In this new update:
[olist]
[*] [b]New NPC, Rhodes[/b] - Rhodes is a new trading friend you’ll meet in the Bast, who has a proposition for you: risk losing a random hard-earned skill to get a brand new Supercomponent upgrade, for better or worse!
[*] [b]The NDA System[/b] - Essentially a new mode that allows you to add restrictions to your run for the ultimate challenge. Sign over your life with the NDA and take on new difficulties!
[*] [b]Cores Currency [/b]- When you complete an NDA run, you’ll receive a new currency to the game: Cores. After your skills are upgraded once, you’ll need both Cores and Credits to upgrade them further.
[*] [b]Dynamic Audio[/b] - You might notice that the music on your stages now changes depending on how the battle is going! 
[*] [b]Modulator Feedback [/b]- Don’t forget to protect the Modulator! Time will now slow and a new sound effect will ring out, meaning it’s time to get serious before it’s too late.
[/olist]

Check out a little sneak peak on how the new Rhodes skills work:

[previewyoutube=18Ty9KDuYWI;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re celebrating the release of the Rhodes update with a 40% discount, so grab Remnants of the Rift now ahead of the final release of the game this year!

See you in the Bast,
Bromio and team 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/

notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content:
Hey, mercenaries!

Remnants of the Rift is back with a new update! We've been working on some balancing lately, so, without further due, let's jump into what's new. 

First off, we've been balancing the difficulty of the game. There's something for everyone: from the beginner player trying to acclimate to the game, to the most seasoned mercenaries looking for a challenge. There are also updates to the enemies and bosses to keep combat fresh and interesting. 

We've added new stages to play in, so get ready for some new areas to explore in The Bast.  

We hope you enjoy this update! If you play the game, be sure to leave a review, it really helps indie game devs!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/ddffc6f05d17e87fe6a3a2136fbc30ef1d8b4cb7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Happy 1-year of Early Access + Update Roadmap!
notes.content:
Remnants of the Rift has officially been available in Early Access for a whole year! Thanks everyone for your continued support and feedback over the last twelve months, we appreciate it so much and continue to get so inspired by your thoughts and feedback. 

We are very much looking forward to bringing you the full game sometime soon, but in the meantime we want to update you on what to expect next for Remnants of the Rift:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/79c9ac08eee9f844965e5af90852b490cc19bba0.png[/img]

That’s right! You can expect the following updates to the game before our full release sometime soon:
[list]
[*] New NPC merchant and shop update
[*] Balance pass to improve difficulty balancing
[*] New systems update that focuses on adding some exciting new gameplay elements
[*] A brand new NPC (and yes, you guessed it, with a new store too!)
[*] And finally, our full run and completed story will be available just before full release!
[/list]

To celebrate the anniversary, we’ve also got a 30% sale running during our anniversary week, available from [b]May 6th to May 13th, 2024[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/

And don’t forget you can play the game NOW in early access or try out the fresh demo available (soon!) until May 13th on Steam!

Happy diving, we’ll see you in the Bast!

P.S. For indie game devs, it especially helps getting Reviews to get more visibility. If you played the game, it’d make Moog the happiest doggo if you share your thoughts here!

notes.title: See Remnants of the Rift on Steam Deck
notes.content:
Hey Friends,

We’ve hit pause on our planning and playing to cross back into your dimension and bring you some updates from behind the scenes since we announced Remants of the Rift.

We have plenty to catch you up on, demo updates, developments on fixes and improvements, a test on the Steam Deck and how much our lovely community is growing. So without further adieu, let's get started. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/256/463/9a3944305bf38d1d360a52115acbaba3_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1652193752&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=b2c9a00e52f314284526ec152f6cf1d4[/img]

[h2]Demo Available![/h2]

We have been making improvements to the game, so of course we wantg to share those with you. So, we have a demo available that you can get right now. Experience some toe-tapping dimension diving for yourself!

What’s more, we won't rest on our laurels and will continue working hard on improvements and fixes to the game. We are committed to making sure each dive into The Bast is as fun as it can be!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/037/256/585/564c66c707a615f482dda6d752bd3a05_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1652194291&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b2a0a0cbd05b778637fc6cda2e125cea[/img]

[h2]Always be Moving[/h2]

Remnants of the Rift is a fast-paced game, you’re always on the move (well except when you pause to plan that is) so why should you be limited to only playing at home? Stuck in one place? If only there was another way. 🤔

Well, we can happily confirm that Remnants of the Rift is running on Steam Deck really well. You can check out some footage of the game in action by clicking on the image below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/432fe3af6d0f23d402bd2ed1f751b9dd00b781a1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Spreading the word[/h2]

We are really proud of Remnants of the Rift and love that word seems to be spreading, getting the game known is important to us and we have seen some amazing growth across our social platforms since we launched our campaign!

[list]
[*] Twitter: +53 new followers ⬆️
[*] Instagram: +5.9k Reach ⬆️
[*] TikTok: +48 New followers ⬆️
[/list]

We want to let the world know about Remnants of the Rift and you can help us by following and sharing across social media. If you’re not already, then please dive in and join our amazing community! 

Until next time… Keep fighting the Megin and keep protecting those Modulators!

Thank you and take care,

Bromio Team

notes.title: A NEW Remnants of the Rift demo LIVE tomorrow with our Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Howdy mercs!

We got some big news for you as we're launching a new demo for Remnants of the Rift tomorrow! 

[b][h3]The new demo goes LIVE alongside our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side]Kickstarter[/url] on May 3rd, 7 AM PDT / 9 AM CDT / 4 PM CEST. 

Do click on the image below to go to our campaign page and hit that "Notify me on launch" button so you don't miss out on the demo news along with Early Bird rewards:[/h3][/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/5ecb93c800542bc78bba60895e94365a735d11eb.png[/img][/url]

[h3]To celebrate the launch of Remnants of the Rift on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1548341006/rfm-a-strategic-roguelike-where-time-is-on-your-side]Kickstarter[/url], members of the Bromio team will be streaming the game, chatting rewards, and answering questions [b]LIVE[/b] right here on the ROTR Steam page and over at twitch.tv/bromiodev from 2pm PDT / 4pm CDT / 10pm BST / 11pm CEST on May 3rd! 

We'd love for you to join us for our big Kickstarter launch celebration stream! ✨[/h3]

Also, how cute are these new illustrations we have for Morgan and Moog?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/f73fe814c863ed3c952c9147e33412b43e8cdc1c.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40739549/5fca9ba4dd24dfafb79ce8d0bc869ac2047871c6.png[/img]


We've got plenty more to share tomorrow and we hope you'll join us for the big day tomorrow when we launch our Kickstarter!

Thanks again,

Bromio

P.S. Still here? It’s May, NSYNC’s month so don’t forget Lance Bass voiced Sephiroth in Kingdom Hearts.
